description: Jarðskjálftar is a dataset listed in Icelandic geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by kortagluggi.is. Gögnin sýna upplýsingar um alla jarðskjálfta á Íslandi. Nánari upplýsingar á. Coverage: IS. Its keywords include jarðhræringar, GSL, jarðskjálftar, Opin gögn. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-is.
